newsitem.title: USA: Banyan Strategic Realty sells property.
newsitem.headline: Banyan Strategic Realty sells property.

text.p: Banyan Strategic Realty Trust said Friday it had sold Hallmark Village Apartments, a 472-unit residential complex in Clarksville, Ind., for $5.9 million and expects to recognize a first quarter gain of $100,000 on the sale.
Banyan, a real estate investment trust, said proceeds from the sale will be used to pay down its revolving credit line.
The Clarksville property was owned by a limited partnership consisting of BSRT Hallmark Village Corp, a subsidiary of the trust, and PHC General Partnership, an unrelated third party.
